dosing.evidence: PSI was prepared in sterile saline (0.9% NaCl) at a 3.0 mg/mL concentration for a dose of 3.0 mg/kg via intraperitoneal injection. Rats were treated within 30 minutes of each head injury (once per day for three days).

assays.assay_description: After each daily i.p. injection of psilocybin (3 mg/kg) or saline on days 1-3, rats were returned to the home cage and video-recorded from above for 10 minutes to quantify head twitches.

outcomes.summary: Head twitches were observed exclusively in psilocybin-treated rats. They occurred only after the first dose, not after the day 2 and day 3 doses, which indicates tolerance/adaptation.
outcomes.evidence: HTR was observed in all PSI-treated rats exclusively, but only after the first dose and not after subsequent administration on day 2 and day 3.

assays.assay_description: Day 5, in the same lidless black box under dim red light. The protocol was a 5-min habituation in the empty box, a 5-min familiarization with two identical objects, then a 5-min test with one familiar and one novel object, with 5-min home-cage intervals between phases. The analyzed measure was the novel-familiar exploration time difference (ANY-maze).

judge_notes: All three candidates identified the same five behavioural assays (HTR, OFT, NOR, Beam Walk, Rotarod). MRI/fMRI/rsFC, lipidomics and Western blot were correctly excluded as non-behavioural.
The study_id follows the modal candidate (Ortiz2025). The author masthead is truncated in the markdown, so the true first author cannot be verified.

D5_followup is set to Yes for NOR (day 5), Beam Walk (day 10) and Rotarod (day 10), following qwen. The last psilocybin dose was on day 3, so these were >=24 h post-dose per the paper's timeline. The other candidates scored these 0 without justification.
D5 for OFT is 0 because the paper states testing occurred 'within 24 hours of the last head impact', so it is not explicitly >=24 h post-dose.
NOR time_to_assay was re-binned to short_term_1to7d (~48 h after the day-3 dose) and Beam Walk/Rotarod to ~7 days (10080 min).
HTR E7 uses the modal value (free social group, 2), because rats were pair-housed and returned to the home cage for recording; confidence is medium since cagemate presence is not explicitly stated.
HTR E3 bedding is scored 0/low because bedding is not reported; deepseek4's inferred Yes was rejected.
NOR B1 is scored 1 measure (the novel-familiar difference was the analyzed variable) and D1 single session (only test-phase data analyzed), following the modal values.
Beam Walk and Rotarod D1 are single session: three trials on one day count as one session (modal).
No test statistics (F/p values) are reported for any behavioural assay, so statistics strings are left empty.
